answer: Price each new identity by its funding delta. To register, an account burns an entry fee equal to the base fee times one plus the number of live identities whose first deposit traced to the same source wallet. Through this prism, an honest agent pays the base fee once, while a farm planting a grove of 100 heads from one wallet pays about 5,000 times base. Dodging that means laundering through many independent sources, and every hop is an on-ledger link that kin rules can flag. Splitting costs more, it is never neutral.
